routing_constraints.account_isolation: never route between Azure and Microsoft Store credential boundaries
routing_constraints.load_balancing: only between semantically equivalent accounts with compatible scope, policy and residency
routing_constraints.fallback: never translate a destructive, RBAC, billing or publication mutation without explicit equivalence and idempotency evidence
routing_constraints.scaling: respect provider quotas, retry headers, cost budgets, concurrency and backpressure
